samir: Heads-up: Billing dashboard shows a group of high-traffic routes billed to project=null. Customers flagging unexpected charges.

hana: Saw same in staging. Root cause looks like the auth router fallback that avoids the identity lookup under overload; it leaves project claim blank.

deploy-bot: deploy: auth-routing v3.0.1 -> canary at 2024-07-02T08:12:00Z

mike: The fallback was intentional to cut latency, but we never added a telemetry signal to indicate a 'shortcut_auth' path. Console can't tell if project was missing or just trimmed.

ops: If we change the fallback to call identity synchronously we risk extra latency and load. Cost impact estimate: ~15% more identity requests during spikes. Need ops sign-off.

zoe: Proposal: emit minimal flags from the auth router on shortcut paths: {shortcut:true, had_project:false, hint_mode:"cached_sa"}. Keep the actual project id out of the event to avoid cardinality explosion. Console can display "inferred project (low confidence)" instead of blank.

claire: UX: show an "attribution mode" pill with tooltip (Claimed / Inferred / Unknown) and a small banner when customers toggle inference on saying numbers may shift. Also add an "explain" link that opens docs.

samir: Implementation note: add a tiny in-proxy SA->project cache (TTL 4m) populated asynchronously. On shortcut paths, set had_project=false and if cache hit set hint_mode=cached_sa and attribution_confidence=MED.

hana: We should also record last_enriched_at timestamp per route so console can indicate staleness.

ops: Add circuit-breaker: if cache miss rate > 40% for 10m, disable hint emission. Also emit metric for hint_on_ratio to monitor impact on billing stats.

mike: I'll open a small RFC for the telemetry schema change and a feature flag for auth.router.emit_hint.

zoe: Rollout plan: 1) Flag off by default. 2) Enable for internal + beta orgs. 3) Enable for 5 pilot customers. 4) If stable after 14 days, expose opt-in toggle in console. 5) Default-on after 60 days with notice.

claire: I'll draft the console copy and banner. Keep language simple: "We may infer project for some requests to improve billing visibility; inferred projects are marked with low confidence."

ops: Who owns runbook? Ops will draft: detection (sudden project->null increase), mitigation (flip flag off), customer comms contact.

samir: Owners: Samir (product), Hana (auth-router), Mike (telemetry schema + RFC), Zoe (backend impl), Claire (console UX), Ops (SRE). Sync tomorrow 9am PT to review RFC.

deploy-bot: ticket created: INFRA-3201 "auth-router: hint flags + attribution mode telemetry"

samir: Thanks all, closing thread.
